# omega8 evidence manifest (99569bd)

Builder-made. The committed copies replace the home path with `<HOME>` and the user name with `<USER>`
(founder instruction, Oct 18 2026), so a copy's hash differs from the gate-attested original whenever such a path
was in it. The originals stay in the session scratchpad (`aegis/omega8/`). The security gate's user-name scan output is committed as
`security/pii-username.txt`; the commit author e-mail is written `<OWNER-EMAIL>`.
